Hi Emma —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery call so we stay aligned on your compliance needs:

- Regulated scope: MedicaHealth handles PHI; HIPAA considerations are primary.
- Current posture: you mentioned SOC 2 Type II is "in flight" and expected mid-Q2.
- Key asks you made: SOC 2 evidence, data residency options, encryption at rest/in transit, and vendor security questionnaire.

Redwood items / proposed next steps:
1) Please share the latest SOC 2 report or attestation you can — even a SOC 2 in-progress summary helps. (If there are sharing restrictions, a short statement of scope + expected completion date is fine.)
2) We will send over our vendor security questionnaire (attached) for your security team to complete. If easier, we can fill it in collaboratively — just let me know a contact and timeframe.
3) Set a 30-minute compliance roadmap meeting next week to discuss ISO 27001 and potential FedRAMP considerations for future procurement. Rishi (security lead) and Lauren (customer success) want to join.
4) If you can share a PHI data flow diagram (even high level), that will speed our internal scoping.

Attachments: Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (redwood template) — I attached our standard questionnaire to get the ball rolling.

Would you be available for a 30-min call on Wed 3/4 or Thu 3/5 (10–12 PT)? If those don't work, propose a time and we will accommodate.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: Security & compliance follow-up — SOC 2, HIPAA, vendor questionnaire

Hi Emma / Tom —

Appreciate the diagram and the early questions. Short answers ahead of Wed's call: 
- BYOK: yes, Redwood supports customer-managed keys via KMS integrations; we can support AWS KMS and Google Cloud KMS for EKM. We also support HSM-backed keys for Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Key rotation: rotation policies can be customer-controlled; we recommend 90-day rotation by default but can support more frequent rotation if required by your policy.
- Data residency: for HIPAA workloads we offer region-specific deployments in US regions (we can limit processing and storage to US-only regions). For stricter on-prem routing, our Redwood Private option supports VPC/on-prem deployments — we can scope that in the MSA if needed.

Proposed mutual action plan (draft):
- Marissa (owner): Send completed Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx to Redwood by 3/10/2026.
- Emma (owner): Upload MedicaHealth responses to the shared Drive by 3/12/2026.
- Rishi (owner): Provide SOC 2 evidence requirements checklist and list of any bridge letters needed by 3/15/2026.
- Lauren (owner): Prepare onboarding & production checklist (incl. BAA/DPA language) by 3/15/2026.

If that looks good, Marissa will attach this MAP to the calendar invite and we will review during the 3/4 call.

Thanks — see you on Wed.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
